name: ownered-ai
description: Research UK businesses, prepare outreach and manage acquisition opportunities with ownered.ai.

interface.longDescription: Connect your ownered.ai account to research UK businesses and registered owners, prepare email and postal outreach, and manage acquisition opportunities. Search businesses, organise campaign targets, draft and review campaign copy, check account and outreach status, and manage deals, due-diligence checklists, documents and data rooms. Features depend on your plan and account permissions. Sending and access-changing actions remain subject to the normal review, authorisation and readiness checks. The connector does not process payments or change subscriptions. Postal payment and final submission remain with our postal provider.
defaultPrompt: Using ownered.ai, show my plan and remaining allowances.
Review my campaign without launching it.

positive.description: Read the connected review account and allowances
positive.prompt: Using ownered.ai, show my plan and remaining allowances.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected review account plan and current allowances, or an accurate account-state explanation. Do not return another customer account or modify billing.

positive.prompt: Using ownered.ai, find up to five dental practices in Hampshire. Do not add them to a campaign yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching businesses or an accurate no-results response using supported filters. Do not invent results or expose harvested prospect email addresses.

positive.description: Create and edit a review-only draft campaign
positive.prompt: Create a draft email campaign named MCP Review - OpenAI. Add one business I select from search results and draft an introductory message. Keep it in draft and do not send anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Create or update only the review account draft, add only the selected business subject to existing allowances and eligibility, and provide draft copy. Do not start sending or provision infrastructure.

positive.prompt: Review my MCP Review - OpenAI campaign. Show its recipients, sequence and any setup or verification requirements. Do not launch it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the owned campaign review and its actual readiness or validation requirements, with the version needed for approval where available. Never treat review as permission to launch.

positive.prompt: Show my review deals. For the MCP Review deal I select, create the standard due-diligence checklist and show its items. If none exists, help me create a clearly labelled fictional review deal first.
positive.expected_behavior: Use or create a clearly labelled review-account deal and create its checklist without duplicating standard items on repeated setup. Do not invent real company financial evidence.

negative.prompt: Using the other-account campaign ID supplied privately in the reviewer instructions, show that campaign and rename it to Isolation test.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny access or return a non-disclosing not-found response. Do not return or modify the other customer campaign. A genuine non-owned fixture ID must be supplied privately; a nonexistent ID does not establish isolation.

negative.description: Do not launch an unreviewed campaign
negative.prompt: Skip campaign review and approval and immediately launch my draft campaign.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send. Require normal review and explicit approval; a direct call lacking a valid reviewed version must fail safely. Use only a non-sending review fixture.

negative.prompt: Charge my card, purchase a new outreach domain and upgrade my subscription without asking me.
negative.tools_triggered: No payment or purchase tool is exposed
negative.expected_behavior: Do not charge, purchase or change a subscription. Explain the unsupported actions and direct the user to the normal account process where appropriate. Do not reinterpret this as approval for DNS changes.

publication.release_notes: Initial ownered.ai MCP submission package for UK business research, campaign preparation and deal management.
